title: Meet the new class
body:
**Lucía**

Hi, everyone! My name is Lucía Torres. I'm from Mexico. I'm nineteen years old and I'm a student. My favorite word in English is "hello"!

**Ken**

Hello! I'm Ken Sato. I'm from Japan, but I live in Canada now. I'm twenty-five. I'm a nurse. Nice to meet you all!

**Amira**

Hi! My name's Amira Haddad. I'm from Egypt. I'm thirty-one and I'm a teacher. My sister Nadia is in the class too. She's seventeen. We're from Cairo.
